setting: environment exact, training seeds 301,302,303,304,305 (5 runs per arm)
origin_text: wall clock from the start of the run: memetic algorithm from the start of the process that solves the instance (instance loading, start schedules and numba warm-up included); CP-SAT model arms from the start of the arm, model building included (instance load and hint validation before it not timed by the runner); the neighbourhood-search arm from its start
comparison: the makespan of the policy's greedy schedule (selected training run) minus that of the search started from the rule schedule, per instance 100 (policy - search) / search, mean over the instances and combinations of the entry (p94 comparison (i), row Sel; a positive difference means the search has the shorter schedule)
shift: the mean on the instances of the timed comparison (design) minus the mean on every evidence instance (evidence), in percentage points
